messages:
oncall-bot: ALERT: High error rate on AcmeCorp (enterprise VPC) traces missing for requests to /generate — 5xx rate 12% over 5m, traces not arriving to observability pipeline. Pager: maria (oncall).

maria (oncall): I can see customer reports in support. No incoming traces for tenant acme-prod from 11:32 UTC. Logs still arriving to storage but traces absent. Paging infra and SRE.

ben (sre): looking. quick check — traces are being dropped at the vpc-forwarder side. Metric shows per-tenant forwarder queue depth spike for acme-prod and forwarder container restart around 11:28.

ajay (infra): pulling forwarder logs from dedicated-pool-7 nodes. There was a config roll that pushed new env var LOG_SILO_MODE=partitioned at 11:25. Could be related.

support-tilly: customer impact: Acme engineering reports degraded debugging (no traces, errors only). They can still send requests; generation latency OK but we can't see spans. They're asking for ETA and status page note.

maria (oncall): immediate ask: can we confirm whether traces are present in the raw S3 bucket/forwarder archive for acme-prod? If present -> routing issue to tracing indexer; if absent -> forwarder dropped them.

eng-runtime: quick grep on s3-forwarder archive shows many request logs but no ddspan payloads for acme-prod for 11:20-11:40 window. Example log snippet:

```
[2025-06-07T11:26:12Z] forwarder=fw-7 pod=fw-7-2 msg="publish_kafka" tenant=acme-prod payload_type=log size=860
[2025-06-07T11:26:12Z] forwarder=fw-7 pod=fw-7-2 msg="publish_kafka" tenant=acme-prod payload_type=trace size=0
[2025-06-07T11:26:12Z] forwarder=fw-7 pod=fw-7-2 msg="drop" tenant=acme-prod reason="partitioned-unknown-target"
```

ben (sre): that drop reason matches a bug in the vpc forwarder when LOG_SILO_MODE=partitioned and tenant route metadata is missing. New config path expects tenant->routing key map from vault but fallback logic returns empty and triggers partition drop.

ajay (infra): confirming: a recent ops change replaced the default mapping secret (vault path secret/acme/route) with a templated reference; the literal path resolved to empty for acme-prod in the new env on dedicated-pool-7. Rolling back is possible but will cause a small restart across forwarder pods.

maria (oncall): mitigation options: 1) quick rollback of env to remove LOG_SILO_MODE or restore secret mapping (fast, requires rolling restart); 2) apply temporary global route default so forwarder treats missing mapping as "fallback" and emits traces to shared pipeline (no restarts for all tenants but needs code path toggle); 3) customer-side workaround (Acme to enable trace sampling to span exporter separately) — not ideal. Recommend rollback to minimize risk.

pagerduty-bot: maria acknowledged the incident at 11:38 UTC.

sophie (acct): customer comms: please prepare a short update for Acme: explaining we found a forwarder config regression impacting trace routing, we're rolling forwarder config back, ETA ~20min, will follow with postmortem. Keep message non-technical.

ben (sre): I'll run the rollback. Steps: restore vault secret path secret/acme/route to previous value and restart forwarder fw-7 set (3 pods) one at a time. Command:

```
# restore secret
vault kv put secret/acme/route routing_key="acme-routing-v1"
# restart pods
kubectl rollout restart deploy/forwarder-fw-7 -n vpc-forwarders
```

ajay (infra): doing secret restore now. patch applied and vault shows routing_key present. Beginning rolling restart sequence.

eng-runtime: while restart goes, adding temporary debug consumer: spin up a sidecar consumer that tails forwarder stdout and forwards any 'drop' events to internal-sre channel for realtime observation.

support-tilly: notified Acme via direct channel: "We're investigating missing traces, root cause appears to be an internal config rollout, working on rollback, ETA 20-30m. We'll update soon."

maria (oncall): current impact: traces absent -> medium SEV for Acme. No request failures, just observability loss. Ticket created: INC-2025-1423.

ben (sre): restart completed for fw-7 pods at 11:52. Observability pipeline shows trace ingestion starting for acme-prod at ~11:54. Confirmed by sample trace id present now.

eng-runtime: confirmed. Sample span: trace_id=0x9f3b4c, service=redwood-runtime, span=/generate, duration=134ms. Also verifying no historical spans were deleted — gaps exist for 11:20-11:40.

maria (oncall): mitigation complete? I want to run through post-steps: 1) Create short postmortem and RCA. 2) Add automated check that vault routes are non-empty before config roll. 3) Add a canary flag to LOG_SILO_MODE to avoid global switch for all tenants. 4) Notify customer with root cause and remediation.

sophie (acct): please include an offer for a short follow-up call with Acme engineering and an apology credit on the account — they'll appreciate proactive reachout.

security-team: flag: confirm no PII leaked in logs while forwarder restarted. We'll run a quick scan on the archived messages for acme-prod for exposure.

maria (oncall): handing off to night oncall ben for follow-up checks and postmortem drafting. Ben, please take ownership for the next 24h to monitor for recurrence and coordinate with infra to land the canary change.

ben (sre): taking it. I'll post a draft RCA in #postmortems and add remediation tickets. Adding alert to check for 'partitioned-unknown-target' drops.

maria (oncall): thanks team. Closing alert thread for now — will re-open if new drop spikes. :white_check_mark:

pagerduty-bot: Incident resolved at 12:40 UTC by ben.

support-tilly: follow-up message sent to Acme with timeline and offered 1 month credit; awaiting reply.

eng-runtime: note for postmortem: historical span gap may affect customer SLOs; include scope and timeframe. Also include logs attached to INC-2025-1423.

ben (sre): logging action items in GH: 1) vault-guard preflight check #3421, 2) forwarder canary flag #3422, 3) add drop alert #3423. I'll take 3421 and 3423.

maria (oncall): handoff complete. If anyone needs to reach night oncall, ping ben directly. Good job everyone. :tada:
